# Builder pipeline kit (@geopjinfo/builder-pipeline)

> A zero-dependency Node (>=18) npm package that gives a software project a multi-agent build pipeline for Claude Code, Codex and Antigravity (and, through prompt files, any agent that reads AGENTS.md or its own rules file). One orchestrator dispatches nine role-scoped personas per module (plan, TDD build, adversarial test, four parallel auditors, docs, review) with git-tracked ledgers checked by scripts, so no work is silently lost and no "done" is unearned. Installing it activates nothing: setup runs `npx builder bootstrap`, then the builder-init skill, and every project fact lives in the project's own PIPELINE_PROFILE.md. Paths below are relative to the package root (in a project: node_modules/@geopjinfo/builder-pipeline/).

## Start here

- [README.md](README.md): what the kit is, install, the one setup prompt per tool, every CLI command, per-tool support
- [FEATURES.md](FEATURES.md): every feature on one page: what it does, how to start it, Claude Code / Codex / Antigravity support, status
- [SETUP_PROMPT.md](SETUP_PROMPT.md): the one setup prompt (bootstrap, then the builder-init skill)
- [USAGE.md](USAGE.md): the operator's runbook: stop points, record points, resuming, troubleshooting

## How it works

- [GUIDE.md](GUIDE.md): the pipeline, mental model, personas, tracks, lite split, batch orchestrator, accounts (the registry, the report, placement, the policy gate, migrating from 1.0 seats), extending, what is in the box
- [DESIGN.md](DESIGN.md): why it works: the principles and the failure lessons behind each rule
- [EXPERIMENTS.md](EXPERIMENTS.md): unproven features, how to switch each on, and the measurement that decides it
- [PIPELINE_PROFILE.template.md](PIPELINE_PROFILE.template.md): the one per-project file; section 16 is the machine-readable settings block
- [DISCOVERY.md](DISCOVERY.md): the agent prompt that fills the profile from the target project's own docs

## Skills and personas

- [skills/build-module-pipeline.md](skills/build-module-pipeline.md): the full per-module pipeline playbook
- [skills/builder-init.md](skills/builder-init.md): setup from inside the AI tool (greenfield or brownfield)
- [skills/spec-author.md](skills/spec-author.md): the opt-in spec authoring stage before Phase 1 (intent to requirement rows, acceptance criteria and an API contract; a person ratifies; templates/spec.md is its shape)
- [skills/orchestrator.md](skills/orchestrator.md): the opt-in batch orchestrator above the pipeline
- [skills/references/account-selection.md](skills/references/account-selection.md): the rulebook for choosing an account (`features.accounts`: ready only, content class, roles, budget, pays order, holds); `npx builder accounts` reports readiness, `npx builder accounts migrate` rewrites the 1.0 seat keys once
- [skills/build-module-lite.md](skills/build-module-lite.md): the experimental lite split (build now, gate later)
- [agents/](agents/): the nine neutral persona sources
- [skills-extra/README.md](skills-extra/README.md): the optional utility skills and how they wire in

## Per tool

- [adapters/claude-code.md](adapters/claude-code.md): Claude Code layout, settings, hooks, accounting, orchestrator templates
- [adapters/codex.md](adapters/codex.md): Codex layout, what is partial, what each Claude-Code-only step becomes
- [adapters/antigravity.md](adapters/antigravity.md): Antigravity layout, tools and models, enforcement gaps
- [adapters/generic.md](adapters/generic.md): any other agent, through prompt files
- [hooks/README.md](hooks/README.md): the guardrail hooks (copied, never armed)

## Optional

- [UNPACK.md](UNPACK.md): the folder-copy install path (no npm)
- [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md): version history; read the entries between your tag and the next before upgrading
- [tooling/PORTING.md](tooling/PORTING.md): porting the run economy (tier runner, knowledge index)
